title: The Descent Part 2
desc: Refusing to believe her story about cave-dwelling monsters, the sole survivor of a spelunking exploration gone horribly wrong is forced to follow the authorities back into the caves where something awaits. The trapped group soon faces the hunger and savage breed of predators while trying to find a way out.

title: Cold Skin
desc: In 1914, a young man arrives at a remote island near the Antarctic Circle to take the post of weather observer only to find himself trapped in a watchtower besieged by deadly creatures which live in hiding on the island.

title: Borrego
desc: Borrego follows our charming botanist Lucy Hales when she's kidnapped by an inexperienced drug mule after his ultra-light plane crashes in the desert. She must fight for her survival while being hunted by the drug cartel.

title: Peter Pan's Neverland Nightmare
desc: He’s every parent’s worst nightmare & is back to ruin your childhood. Fifteen years ago, Peter Pan worked at a fantasy-themed circus known as "Neverland" where he performs as a mime for many children. Attempting to abduct James Peter’s face is mutilated by his mother. Now Wendy Darling strikes out an attempt to rescue her brother from 'the clutches of the evil Peter Pan.'

title: Girl You Know It's True
desc: The biggest scandal in music history. The unbelievable but true story of Milli Vanilli. They became global stars with three No. 1 hits in the USA. But only a small circle of insiders knew that the duo was not singing but merely move their lips to the voices of the two other artists. Excesses of fame and drug addiction in Hollywood turns in infamy and in a con that their fans cannot forgive.
